title: Safety Alignment Can Be Not Superficial With Explicit Safety Signals

layout.note: A 2 by 2 grid inside one dashed frame: rows are the training phase (pretraining on top, SFT below), columns are the view (token strip with labels on the left, attention-mask matrix with its legend on the right); each cell has a caption underneath.

lesson: Draw a change of training format as aligned pairs: the token strip with labels, and the attention mask whose headers repeat the strip's colours, so that a special token visibly changes both the data layout and who attends to whom; redraw the same grid per phase so that only the changed cells differ.
